newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-MASTERKOVA STRETCHERED OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MASTERKOVA STRETCHERED OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Russia's double Olympic champion Svetlana Masterkova left the world championships arena on a stretcher on Sunday after pulling up with a leg injury in the women's 1,500 metres semifinals.
Masterkova, who dominated the 800 and 1,500 metres at last year's Atlanta Olympics, pulled up in the last 100 metres of the heat and hobbled over the line in last place.
The Russian, who looked far from her best in the first round on Saturday, was carried away on a stretcher.
